title: Search
summary: AI-aware site search across tools and feed posts. Falls back to instant fuzzy keyword matching; uses Qwen3.5 for natural-language summaries when the model is already cached locally.

title: Step Counter
summary: Session pedometer using your phone's motion sensor — goal ring, 7-day history, streaks, a black-screen pocket mode that keeps counting in your pocket, and honest estimates for locked-screen gaps. All on-device.

title: QR & Barcode Scanner + Generator
summary: Scan QR codes and barcodes, or generate a QR code from any link or text — all on-device, nothing uploaded.

title: Decision Wheel
summary: Offline-ready spinner for quick calls: Yes, No, Up to you, or Wait & try again.

title: Countdown Timer
summary: Up to 4 simultaneous countdown timers with custom titles. Set a duration or pick a target date & time (max 99 hrs).

title: Coin Flip
summary: Animated heads or tails coin flip with optional best-of-N series mode. Works offline.

title: Quick Notes
summary: Minimal scratchpad that saves to your browser. Supports multiple notes with localStorage persistence.

title: Base64 Codec
summary: Encode and decode text or files (including images) to and from Base64. All processing stays in your browser.

title: TOTP
summary: Two-factor codes that live in your browser, not on a server. Encrypted at rest, unlocked with a passphrase or Touch ID. Mandatory encrypted backup before your first secret saves.

title: EXIF Inspector
summary: See the metadata hiding in a photo — camera, timestamps, GPS position — and download a byte-identical clean copy with it all stripped. Nothing is uploaded.

title: Color Picker
summary: Pick colors, generate harmonious palettes, and copy values in HEX, RGB, and HSL. Works offline.

title: Annotate Image
summary: Upload an image, get an instant on-device AI description, alt-text, transcription, or tags — tested one-tap prompts, nothing uploaded. Open images straight from your file manager.

title: AI Chat
summary: Chat with Qwen3.5 running locally in your browser via WebGPU. Supports vision. No data leaves your device.

title: Motivational Quote
summary: AI-generated original motivational quotes. Runs locally in your browser.

title: Infinite Radio
summary: AI-generated epic cinematic music streaming infinitely. Learns your taste locally. No data leaves your device.

title: Invoice Generator
summary: Build clean, single-page invoices in your browser. Auto-saves, prints to A4, exports/imports JSON. No data leaves your device.

title: Markdown → PDF
summary: Write markdown, see a live preview, and download a clean professional PDF. Auto-saves to your browser. No data leaves your device.

title: Tetris
summary: Browser-native Tetris in the Mentria synthwave palette. Touch, keyboard, and mouse supported. Plays offline.

title: Breakout
summary: Brick-buster paddle game with synthwave powerups, lives, and a high-score table. Plays offline.

title: Flappy
summary: Paper plane flapping through stacks of command prompts. Tap, click, or SPACE. Plays offline.

title: Minesweeper
summary: Classic logic puzzle in terminal dress. Three difficulties, mouse + touch input, best-time tracking. Plays offline.

title: Sudoku
summary: Unique-solution generator, four difficulties, pencil marks, conflict highlighting, hints, and per-difficulty best times. Keyboard, mouse, and touch. Plays offline.

title: Ludo
summary: The cross-and-circle race game on canvas. Roll, capture, race four tokens home. 2–4 players vs built-in bots or pass-and-play. Plays offline.

title: Chess
summary: Full-rules chess with a local alpha-beta engine (four strengths), hot-seat, and encrypted online play via share-code. Eval bar, hints, move history. Plays offline.

title: Extensions
summary: Install private single-file extensions that live only on your device — they get a launcher tile, terminal commands, and local storage, and are never part of the public site.

title: Files
summary: Browse, export, and delete everything Mentria tools store on this device — notes, TOTP vault, game state, extension data, and legacy keys. View any value, export a single item, or download an encrypted backup of it all. Nothing leaves your device.

title: Comms
summary: Peer-to-peer chat, voice and video calls, and file drop. End-to-end encrypted rooms, contact codes, and private DMs derived from your identity. No accounts, no server in the middle.

title: Bubble Level
summary: Spirit level for your phone — a bubble level online with no app needed. Circular two-axis bubble when the phone lies flat, single-vial carpenter's level on edge, 0.1° readouts, tap-to-freeze and one-tap calibration. Works offline, all on-device.

title: Decibel Meter
summary: Sound level meter online — measure noise in decibels with your phone or laptop mic, no app to install. Live dB reading with color ramp, peak-hold meter, session min/average/peak, adjustable calibration offset, and a ladder of everyday sounds for context. Honest estimates, not a calibrated instrument. Audio is analysed on-device and never recorded or uploaded.

title: Compass
summary: Compass online with no app to install — works right in the browser and reads your magnetic heading from your phone's magnetometer. Rotating rose, tap-to-lock bearing, calibration hint. All on-device.

title: GPS Speedometer
summary: GPS speedometer online without an app — live speed in km/h, mph or knots on a big auto-ranging dial, plus trip distance, moving time, average and top speed. Reads your device GPS in the browser; the position never leaves the device.

title: Online Ruler
summary: Online ruler at actual size — centimetres, millimetres and inches down to 1/16 on screen. Calibrate once with a bank card (or a length you already know) so the marks are true to size, then drag two markers to measure anything you lay on the glass. Works offline; calibration stays on your device.
